title: DSV-Mem: Evaluating Multimodal Memory in Professional Workflows for MLLM Agents
title_zh: DSV-Mem：评估多模态记忆在 MLLM 智能体专业工作流程中的应用

paragraphs.en: Conversational MLLM agents are increasingly expected to assist in professional workflows: from AI research and engineering design to product management and business operations. Despite this growing need, this capability has not been well explored: existing benchmarks largely focus on informal, everyday interactions and personal-life scenarios that typically feature photographic natural images, isolated, static artifacts, and recall-oriented questions. In contrast, professional scenarios often involve structured, information-heavy artifacts that undergo frequent revisions and authority updates, as well as compositional queries that require reconciling many artifact versions in memory while tracking state precisely. To address these challenges, we introduce DSV-Mem , a carefully curated benchmark for evaluating D ense S tateful V isual Mem ory. DSV-Mem comprises a diverse suite of expert-reviewed scenarios and 1,000 questions across five user-oriented categories (Current State, Past State, Derived State, Change History, and Conflict/Refusal). Moreover, a Hartley-inspired criterion is introduced to favor questions with broader visual-evidence inspection demands. To support further study, we introduce a generation harness that produces high-quality, domain-specific evaluation suites by decoupling state-transition synthesis from conversation filling. Rigorous evaluation over 27 configurations spanning frontier, open-weight models and popular memory management methods reveals that even the strongest baseline scores below 45 % 45\% on DSV-Mem. Comprehensive analysis surfaces several important findings: 1) multimodality and information density both contribute to difficulty, but state evolution , particularly the number of governing updates, is the dominant tested factor. Raw conversation/haystack length, OCR and arithmetic are not the primary bottlenecks; 2) models frequently fail to verify user premises against prior state updates before answering; 3) popular interventions such as increased reasoning effort and memory management methods yield limited gains, whereas state-aware designs prove more effective. The benchmark & code will be publicly released.
paragraphs.zh: 人们越来越期望对话式 MLLM 智能体能够协助专业工作流程：从人工智能研究和工程设计，到产品管理和业务运营。 尽管需求日益增长，但这种能力尚未得到充分探索：现有基准测试主要关注非正式的日常互动和个人生活场景，这些场景通常涉及摄影风格的自然图像、孤立的静态物品以及以回忆为导向的问题。 相比之下，专业场景往往涉及结构严谨、信息密集且频繁修订和更新权限的物品，以及需要同时记忆多个物品版本并精确追踪状态的组合式查询。 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 DSV-Mem——一个经过精心设计的基准测试，用于评估深度状态视觉记忆（D ense S tateful V isual Mem ory）。 DSV-Mem 包含一套由专家审核的多样化场景和 1,000 个问题，涵盖五个以用户为导向的类别（当前状态、过去状态、派生状态、变更历史和冲突/拒绝）。 此外，我们还引入了一种受哈特利启发的标准，以优先选择对视觉证据审查要求更广泛的问题。 为支持进一步研究，我们提出了一种生成框架，通过将状态转换合成与对话填充解耦，来生成高质量、领域特定的评估套件。 针对前沿模型、开放权重模型和主流记忆管理方法等 27 种配置进行的严格评估表明，即便是最强的基线模型在 DSV-Mem 上的得分也低于 45%（45\%）。 全面分析揭示了若干重要发现：1）多模态性和信息密度都会增加难度，但状态演化——尤其是主导性更新的数量——是测试中的主要因素； 原始对话/资料库长度、OCR 和算术能力并非主要瓶颈；2）模型在回答前经常未能根据先前的状态更新验证用户前提；3）增加推理努力度和采用记忆管理方法等常见干预措施效果有限，而具备状态感知能力的方案则更为有效。 该基准测试及代码将公开发布。

paragraphs.en: Conversational MLLM agents are increasingly deployed in extended professional workflows beyond isolated everyday tasks ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Xi et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . For instance, designers generate and iteratively refine complex campaign graphics, while ML researchers repeatedly analyze evolving tables and plots, and revise paper drafts as experiments progress. Unlike everyday conversations, these scenarios often exhibit distinctive features: 1) information-heavy visuals: they center on structured, data-heavy artifacts such as dense worksheets, dashboards, or intricate graphic designs rather than ordinary photographic scenes; 2) statefulness: uploaded artifacts frequently undergo revisions, scope changes, and authority updates; and 3) analytical queries: users go beyond single-fact questions to compositional ones that compare, aggregate, or derive quantities across visuals and revisions. Meeting these demands requires robust stateful multimodal memory, such as precise state tracking that reconciles evidence across many versions, and assessing such capabilities is essential for measuring progress toward reliable professional MLLM agents.
paragraphs.zh: 对话式 MLLM 智能体正越来越多地部署在扩展的专业工作流程中，而不再局限于孤立的日常任务（Hu et al., 2025；Xi et al., 2023；Wang et al., 2025）。 例如，设计师会生成并迭代优化复杂的营销方案图形，而机器学习研究人员则会反复分析不断变化的表格和图表，并在实验推进过程中修改论文初稿。 与日常对话不同，这些场景通常具有独特的特征：1）信息密集型视觉内容：它们以结构化、数据密集型的产物为核心，例如密集的电子表格、仪表盘或复杂的图形设计，而非普通的摄影场景；2）状态保持性：上传的产物经常经历修订、范围变更和权限更新；以及 3）分析性查询：用户的问题不再局限于单一事实，而是转向需要跨视觉内容和不同版本进行比较、汇总或推导数值的组合式问题。 满足这些需求需要强大的状态保持型多模态记忆能力，例如能够协调多个版本中证据的精确状态追踪；评估此类能力对于衡量向可靠的专业 MLLM 智能体发展的进展至关重要。

paragraphs.en: Despite this growing need, existing efforts to evaluate multimodal memory largely focus on informal, everyday interactions and personal-life scenarios, featuring photographic visuals ( Maharana et al., 2024 ; Bei et al., 2026 ; Ren et al., 2026 ; Guo et al., 2026 ) , static artifacts ( Maharana et al., 2024 ; Bei et al., 2026 ; Ren et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) , or recall-oriented questions ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026a ) , rather than the dense visuals, stateful artifacts, and analytical queries that professional workflows demand. Moreover, our careful analysis shows many of them average fewer than three evidence images per question, often one or none ( Bei et al., 2026 ) , and may be largely saturated for frontier systems: Gemini-3.7-Flash already exceeds 90% on LoCoMo ( Maharana et al., 2024 ) . Most importantly, none of these settings jointly capture the properties and complexity of real-world workflows encountered in practice ( Figure 1 ).

paragraphs.en: However, curating such a benchmark is highly nontrivial: Without explicit state propagation control, directly prompting an LLM/agent often yields repetitive dialogues with homogeneous or corrupted state transitions. These degraded trajectories in turn produce shallow QAs with incorrect, unverifiable labels. Conversely, manual creation limits controlled modifications, making systematic study of the underlying factors difficult. To this end, we develop a generation harness that produces high-quality conversations requiring only modest curation effort. Our key design principles are 1) the decoupling of state-trajectory construction from surface conversation realization, and 2) a Hartley-inspired criterion for cross-visual QA construction, with 7.78 candidate visual artifacts per QA in DSV-Mem (geometric mean), substantially higher than similar benchmarks ( Table 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 然而，构建这样一个基准数据集绝非易事：如果没有明确的状态传播控制，直接提示大型语言模型（LLM）或智能体往往会生成重复性对话，其状态转换要么单一化，要么出现错误。 这些退化的轨迹反过来又会生成浅层的问答对，其中包含不正确且无法验证的标签。 相反，手动创建方式限制了受控修改的可能性，使得对潜在因素的系统性研究变得困难。 为此，我们开发了一种生成框架，能够生成高质量的对话，仅需较少的整理工作即可。 我们的核心设计原则包括：1）将状态轨迹的构建与表层对话的实现解耦；2）采用受哈特利启发的跨视觉问答构建标准。在 DSV-Mem 中，每个问答对平均包含 7.78 个候选视觉元素（几何平均值），显著高于同类基准数据集（表 1）。

paragraphs.en: We conduct rigorous evaluation of 27 configurations spanning advanced frontier and open MLLMs and popular memory management methods. DSV-Mem remains hard for all evaluated baselines: the best-performing baselines among our evaluations, Gemini-3.7-Flash, achieves below 45% with over 80% of the errors concentrated on state reconstruction rather than computation or OCR. Beyond this, a large memory capability gap exists between the best compact open-weight systems and frontier MLLMs. Common interventions offer little: increased reasoning effort shows limited gains, and existing memory management solutions or simple supervised fine-tuning (SFT) provide limited gains. Moreover, a controlled ablation shows all three properties matter but statefulness dominates: removing statefulness improves matched-category accuracy by 43.2 pp, versus 12.6 pp for density reduction and 8.2 pp for visual-to-text conversion. Based on these insights, we explore a lightweight state-aware inference-time algorithm that proves effective ( + 13.6 − 26 % +13.6-26\% overall), yet further improvement may require efforts beyond simple scaffolding or SFT. Our contributions are threefold:

paragraphs.en: LoCoMo, LongMemEval, and EverMemBench evaluate conversational recall, temporal reasoning, and knowledge updates, but do not center on reconstructing fine-grained state across revisions of dense visual artifacts ( Maharana et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) . Mem-Gallery, MemLens, and M 3 Exam evaluate multimodal histories and heterogeneous evidence, while H2HMem studies human–human interactions; these settings do not focus on cumulative artifact revisions and authority changes within sustained professional workflows ( Bei et al., 2026 ; Ren et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) . LongMemEval-V2 and WorldMemArena include dynamic state tracking, but emphasize reusable environment knowledge and action–world memory, respectively, rather than compositional analysis of dense, repeatedly revised records ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026a ) . MemEye evaluates fine-grained visual evidence and evolutionary synthesis, but emphasizes visual granularity and reasoning depth across life scenarios ( Guo et al., 2026 ) . DSV-Mem instead centers on the interaction between visual density and state evolution : compositional queries require reconciling field-level updates and source authority across revisions of dense professional artifacts, rather than recalling individual state changes in isolation.

paragraphs.en: Generative Agents and MemoryBank emphasize reflection and personalized recall, while MemGPT and MemoryOS manage hierarchical memory, prioritizing conversational continuity rather than reconstruction of evolving visual records ( Park et al., 2023 ; Zhong et al., 2023 ; Packer et al., 2024 ; Kang et al., 2025 ) . LongMem retrieves cached text, HippoRAG links knowledge for multi-hop retrieval, and A-Mem evolves interconnected notes, emphasizing contextual access and semantic organization rather than explicit field-level authority across artifact versions ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Jiménez Gutiérrez et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) . Mem0 extracts and updates salient facts, while SimpleMem and LightMem compress and consolidate interactions; such compression poses challenges for professional workflows, where minor details may govern later state-dependent queries ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026b ; Fang et al., 2026 ) . DSV-Mem tests these demands: all four evaluated integrations underperform their baselines, highlighting the challenge of preserving and reconciling dense, state-bearing details .

paragraphs.en: Rigorous evaluation of dense stateful visual memory requires conversation trajectories that jointly satisfy three constraints : (i) domain-faithful dense visual artifacts, (ii) diverse and explicit state transitions with verifiable ground truth, and (iii) coherent long-form interactions. However, directly prompting an LLM to generate complete trajectories often produces repetitive dialogue, poorly motivated shifts in the workflow, and limited transition diversity. More fundamentally, unlike static settings, evolving scenarios require accepted state to be explicitly propagated and validated across all updates to prevent inconsistent evidence and QA labels. To overcome these challenges, we decouple latent state-trajectory construction from dialogue realization through a generation harness ( Figure 2 ). Starting from an initial artifact and state, the harness samples eligible operations—such as visual-value edits, textual corrections, and authority changes—from a predefined transition library. Each operation is instantiated against the current state, checked for pre- and post-condition consistency, and recorded with its accepted effects and evidence provenance. Two-model role-play then realizes the validated trajectory as natural dialogue, interleaving updates with ordinary interaction. The resulting dialogue is then checked for coherence, state consistency, and answer leakage. This decoupled design enables controlled, diverse trajectories and coherent dialogue, keeps QAs traceable to validated states, and requires only light post-hoc review. Full details are specified in subsection B.1 and subsection B.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 对密集状态视觉记忆的严格评估需要对话轨迹同时满足三个约束：(i) 领域内真实可信的密集视觉元素，(ii) 多样化且明确的、具有可验证基准事实的状态转换，以及 (iii) 连贯的长形式交互。 然而，直接提示大型语言模型生成完整的对话轨迹，往往会产出重复性的对话、动机不足的流程转变，以及有限的状态转换多样性。 更根本的是，与静态设置不同，动态发展的场景要求已接受的状态在所有更新中都被明确传播和验证，以防止证据与问答标签之间出现不一致。 为克服这些挑战，我们通过一个生成框架（图 2），将潜在状态-轨迹的构建与对话实现相分离。 从初始的视觉元素和状态出发，该框架会从预定义的状态转换库中采样符合条件的操作，例如视觉值编辑、文本修正和权限变更。 每个操作都会基于当前状态进行实例化，检查其前后条件的一致性，并记录其被接受的影响及证据来源。 随后，通过双模型角色扮演，将验证后的轨迹转化为自然对话，在常规交互中穿插更新内容。 生成的对话将进一步被检查其连贯性、状态一致性和答案泄露问题。 这种解耦设计能够生成受控且多样化的轨迹与连贯的对话，确保问答可追溯至已验证的状态，并且仅需轻量级的后续审查。 完整细节在子章节 B.1 和子章节 B.2 中进行了说明。

sents.en: Rigorous evaluation of dense stateful visual memory requires conversation trajectories that jointly satisfy three constraints : (i) domain-faithful dense visual artifacts, (ii) diverse and explicit state transitions with verifiable ground truth, and (iii) coherent long-form interactions.
sents.zh: 对密集状态视觉记忆的严格评估需要对话轨迹同时满足三个约束：(i) 领域内真实可信的密集视觉元素，(ii) 多样化且明确的、具有可验证基准事实的状态转换，以及 (iii) 连贯的长形式交互。

sents.en: However, directly prompting an LLM to generate complete trajectories often produces repetitive dialogue, poorly motivated shifts in the workflow, and limited transition diversity.
sents.zh: 然而，直接提示大型语言模型生成完整的对话轨迹，往往会产出重复性的对话、动机不足的流程转变，以及有限的状态转换多样性。

sents.en: More fundamentally, unlike static settings, evolving scenarios require accepted state to be explicitly propagated and validated across all updates to prevent inconsistent evidence and QA labels.
sents.zh: 更根本的是，与静态设置不同，动态发展的场景要求已接受的状态在所有更新中都被明确传播和验证，以防止证据与问答标签之间出现不一致。

sents.en: To overcome these challenges, we decouple latent state-trajectory construction from dialogue realization through a generation harness ( Figure 2 ).
sents.zh: 为克服这些挑战，我们通过一个生成框架（图 2），将潜在状态-轨迹的构建与对话实现相分离。

sents.en: Starting from an initial artifact and state, the harness samples eligible operations—such as visual-value edits, textual corrections, and authority changes—from a predefined transition library.
sents.zh: 从初始的视觉元素和状态出发，该框架会从预定义的状态转换库中采样符合条件的操作，例如视觉值编辑、文本修正和权限变更。

sents.en: Each operation is instantiated against the current state, checked for pre- and post-condition consistency, and recorded with its accepted effects and evidence provenance.
sents.zh: 每个操作都会基于当前状态进行实例化，检查其前后条件的一致性，并记录其被接受的影响及证据来源。

sents.en: Two-model role-play then realizes the validated trajectory as natural dialogue, interleaving updates with ordinary interaction.
sents.zh: 随后，通过双模型角色扮演，将验证后的轨迹转化为自然对话，在常规交互中穿插更新内容。

sents.en: The resulting dialogue is then checked for coherence, state consistency, and answer leakage.
sents.zh: 生成的对话将进一步被检查其连贯性、状态一致性和答案泄露问题。

sents.en: This decoupled design enables controlled, diverse trajectories and coherent dialogue, keeps QAs traceable to validated states, and requires only light post-hoc review.
sents.zh: 这种解耦设计能够生成受控且多样化的轨迹与连贯的对话，确保问答可追溯至已验证的状态，并且仅需轻量级的后续审查。

sents.en: Full details are specified in subsection B.1 and subsection B.2 .

paragraphs.en: To ensure a high quality bar, we conduct three layers of validation: automated checks, independent human auditing, and domain-expert review. Automated checks cover release integrity, accidental answer leakage, duplicate questions, and computational consistency. Three PhD students independently audit a 100-question sample set, with reviewer-averaged gold-answer agreement of 98.3% , question clarity of 97.7% , visual-evidence consistency of 98.7% , and confirmation of cross-visual necessity of 99.0% . On this sample, Gemini-3.7-Flash achieves only 2% accuracy without images and 1% with a single image, versus 93% when supplied with the supporting evidence, confirming cross-visual dependence and answerability . We additionally invite domain experts to review each scenario’s initial artifact and transition trajectory for professional realism , appropriate terminology and units, plausible updates, and correctly propagated consequences. Identified erroneous questions were replaced (fewer than 5% of the benchmark). Seven complementary validations further assess result robustness ( section 4 ); more details are presented in subsection C.4 and subsection C.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 为确保高质量标准，我们进行了三层验证：自动化检查、独立人工审计以及领域专家审核。 自动化检查涵盖发布完整性、意外答案泄露、重复问题以及计算一致性。 三名博士生独立审计了一个包含100道题的样本集，评审员平均黄金答案一致率为98.3%，问题清晰度为97.7%，视觉证据一致性为98.7%，跨视觉必要性的确认率为99.0%。 在该样本中，Gemini-3.7-Flash在无图像时仅达到2%的准确率，单张图像时为1%，而提供支持性证据后则达到93%，这证实了其对跨视觉信息的依赖性和可回答性。 我们还邀请领域专家审核每个场景的初始成果和转换轨迹，以评估其专业真实性、恰当的术语和单位、合理的更新以及正确传递的后果。 已识别出的错误问题被替换（占基准测试的比例低于5%）。 七项补充验证进一步评估了结果的稳健性（第4节）；更多细节见C.4小节和C.5小节。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 27 total configurations : frontier MLLMs (Gemini-3.1-Pro/3.5-Flash-Lite/3.6-Flash/3.7-Flash ( Google DeepMind, 2026c ; Google DeepMind, 2026a ; Google DeepMind, 2026b ; Google DeepMind, 2026d ) ), open-weight MLLMs (MiniMax-M3 ( MiniMax, 2026 ) , GLM-4.6V ( Z.ai, 2025 ) , Kimi-K3/K2.5 ( Kimi Team, 2026b ; Kimi Team, 2026a ) , Qwen-3.5 ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , and Gemma-4 ( Gemma Team, 2026 ) ), prompt variants (CoT ( Wei et al., 2022 ) , state-tracking hints, and question rephrasing), and memory-management methods (Mem0, SimpleMem, LightMem, and MIRIX ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026b ; Fang et al., 2026 ; Wang & Chen, 2025 ) ). Following prior memory benchmarks ( Ren et al., 2026 ; Bei et al., 2026 ) , we use a web-style conversational setting: Each question is evaluated independently as the final user turn, with the full conversation and visible multimodal evidence. Memory-management methods instead receive retrieved memories and question-attached images ( subsection D.6 ). Models use medium reasoning effort unless otherwise specified. We use a two-stage LLM judge–verifier pipeline ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) , with GPT-5.5 as the primary judge. More details are in subsection D.1 .

paragraphs.en: We adopt a robust set of validation procedures to validate results. 1) Run stability. Unless otherwise specified, results are averaged over three independent runs. 2) Prompt robustness. Three semantically equivalent rewrites of each question change accuracy by less than one percentage point. 3) Two-stage judge verification. Responses initially judged incorrect receive an additional independent judgment. 4) Human–judge agreement. Three PhD students independently grade 200 responses, with over 90% agreement with reported labels across 600 individual judgments. 5) Cross-judge robustness. GPT-5.5 (reported judge), Claude Opus 4.6, and Gemini 3.1 Pro achieve over 93% agreement. 6) Visual-reading (OCR) control. Isolated visual-content extraction across conversation depths achieves 98.5% accuracy. More details are in subsection C.5 . 7) Error-stage validation. Three PhD students independently classify 200 failures; human-majority labels agree with automated classifications in 96% of cases ( subsection D.3 ).

paragraphs.en: Table 2 yields six main findings. 1) Dense, stateful visual memory remains challenging for all systems. All model baselines and variants score below 45% overall, ranging from 3.3% to just 43.4% for Gemini 3.7 Flash with hints, leaving substantial headroom. 2) Models generally track values’ current states better than their update histories/trajectories. Gemini 3.7 Flash, for example, achieves 61.7% on Current State but only 27.8% on Change History . 3) Models exhibit dissociated capability profiles. Qwen3.5-397B-A17B outperforms MiniMax M3 on Current and Past State, yet trails it on Conflict/Refusal by 9.2 pp (6.8% vs. 16.0%). 4) A substantial gap exists between compact open-weight models and frontier proprietary systems. Qwen3.5-27B, the strongest compact open-weight model evaluated, scores only 9.6% overall versus Gemini 3.7 Flash’s 39.6%. 5) Generic inference-time interventions and memory-management methods yield limited gains. Compared to the Gemini-3.7-Flash baseline (39.6%), CoT yields only a 1.2-point gain (40.8%), while a targeted hint prompt emphasizing version differences yields a modest 3.8-point gain. More importantly, all tested memory-management methods perform below baseline. Most of these methods compress visual histories into textual memories without re-attaching visual images, thus fail to preserve fine-grained details, highlighting DSV-Mem’s unique challenge: preserving dense, state-bearing details in professional scenarios that ordinary compression loses . 6) Prompting effects differ across models. Kimi K3 responds much more strongly to CoT with a 11.9-pp gain vs. 1.2-pp with Gemini.

paragraphs.en: To understand the low performance in Table 2 , we next analyze a key question: where do models fail? We classify incorrect responses from Gemini-3.7-flash, Kimi-K3, MiniMax-M3, and Qwen3.5-397B-A17B by their earliest failure stage into five categories: 1) evidence acquisition, retrieving the wrong artifact or misreading visual content; 2) state reconstruction, incorrectly tracking or reconciling updates; 3) downstream computation, incorrect arithmetic; 4) decision/response, missed refusals, hallucinations, or incorrect answers despite correct reasoning; and 5) other. Figure 5 a&b shows that state reconstruction dominates at 89.7% of all errors and across all categories; human annotation corroborates this pattern, attributing 85% of sampled failures to state reconstruction (96% agreement with automated labels) ( subsection D.3 ). In contrast, decision/response contributes a modest share (5.5%) while evidence acquisition and downstream computation contribute little (3.5% and 1.0%), suggesting that the main challenge lies in tracking and maintaining valid states whereas hallucination, visual understanding, and arithmetics/downstream computation are not the primary bottlenecks.
paragraphs.zh: 为了理解表2中表现不佳的原因，我们接下来分析一个关键问题：模型在哪些环节会出现失败？ 我们将 Gemini-3.7-flash、Kimi-K3、MiniMax-M3 和 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 的错误响应，根据其最早出现的故障阶段分为五类：1）证据获取，即检索错误的数据或误读视觉内容；2）状态重建，即错误地跟踪或协调更新信息；3）下游计算，即计算错误；4）决策/响应，即在推理正确的情况下仍出现拒绝判断失误、幻觉或错误答案；以及 5）其他。 图5a和b显示，在所有错误中，状态重建占比高达89.7%，且这一比例在所有类别中均占主导地位；人工标注也证实了这一模式，将所采样故障的85%归因于状态重建（与自动化标签的一致性达96%）（D.3节）。 相比之下，决策/响应仅占较小比例（5.5%），而证据获取和下游计算的贡献则微乎其微（分别为3.5%和1.0%），这表明主要挑战在于跟踪并维持有效的状态，而非幻觉、视觉理解以及算术或下游计算环节。

paragraphs.en: Having identified state reconstruction as the main memory bottleneck ( subsection 4.2 ), we next investigate a crucial question: which properties of professional workflows make it difficult . We hypothesize that such difficulty lies mainly in DSV-Mem’s defining characteristics, namely multimodality, information density, evolving visual information ( section 1 ). However, the main evaluation combines all three in a fixed setting, preventing us from isolating their respective contributions. To address this, we design controlled interventions by varying each factor individually: 1) multimodality ( oracle visual-to-text ), replacing each visual artifact with a faithful textual rendering; 2) information density ( density reduced ), retaining only information required for the target question; and 3) state evolution ( statefulness removed ), removing stateful changes to the targeted field.
paragraphs.zh: 在确定状态重建是主要内存瓶颈（第 4.2 小节）之后，我们接下来研究一个关键问题：专业工作流程的哪些特性使其变得困难。 我们假设这种困难主要源于 DSV-Mem 的核心特征，即多模态性、信息密度和动态变化的视觉信息（第 1 节）。 然而，主要评估将这三种特性在固定设置中结合使用，使我们无法区分它们各自的贡献。 为了解决这个问题，我们通过单独改变每个因素来设计受控干预：1）多模态性（神谕视觉转文本），即用忠实的文本呈现替换每个视觉元素；2）信息密度（密度降低），仅保留目标问题所需的信息；以及 3）状态演化（移除状态性），即消除目标字段的状态变化。

paragraphs.en: To further dissect what makes evolving state difficult to maintain , we specifically examine when state tracking becomes harder and how it fails through four analyses: 1) context length , adding 0–96K tokens of question-irrelevant content while preserving the governing evidence; 2) update count , grouping questions by the number of governing state updates; 3) recency , grouping questions by turns since the latest governing update; and 4) failure subtype , decomposing state-reconstruction errors by the operation mishandled. Figure 7 reveals an interesting contrast: accuracy generally declines with increasing update count , whereas added haystack produces little variation (45.3–48.3%) and recency shows model-dependent behavior. The subtype analysis ( Figure 5 ) further shows that lost/collapsed updates (30% of all errors) and stale values (27.1%) are the largest failure modes, while other reconstruction errors span update integration, entity tracking, and authority resolution. Together, these results suggest that reliable memory requires a state-aware approach that preserves and reconciles accumulating updates across multiple state operations in the memory — which we prototype as a lightweight self-ledger in section 5 below.
paragraphs.zh: 为了进一步剖析使状态演化难以维持的关键因素，我们通过四项分析具体考察了状态追踪何时变得困难以及其失效方式：1）上下文长度，在保留核心证据的同时添加 0–96K 个与问题无关的标记；2）更新次数，根据核心状态的更新次数对问题进行分组；3）时效性，根据自上次核心更新以来的轮次对问题进行分组；4）失效子类型，根据错误处理的操作类型对状态重建错误进行分解。 图 7 揭示了一个有趣的对比：随着更新次数的增加，准确率通常会下降，而添加的“干草堆”内容几乎不会造成变化（45.3%–48.3%），时效性则表现出因模型而异的行为。 子类型分析（图 5）进一步表明，丢失/崩溃的更新（占所有错误的 30%）和过时的值（27.1%）是主要的失效模式，而其他重建错误则涉及更新整合、实体追踪和权限解析。 综合来看，这些结果表明，可靠的记忆需要一种具备状态感知能力的方法，该方法能够在记忆系统中跨多次状态操作保留并协调累积的更新——我们在下文第 5 节中将其原型设计为一个轻量级的自我账本。

sents.zh: 为了进一步剖析使状态演化难以维持的关键因素，我们通过四项分析具体考察了状态追踪何时变得困难以及其失效方式：1）上下文长度，在保留核心证据的同时添加 0–96K 个与问题无关的标记；2）更新次数，根据核心状态的更新次数对问题进行分组；3）时效性，根据自上次核心更新以来的轮次对问题进行分组；4）失效子类型，根据错误处理的操作类型对状态重建错误进行分解。

sents.en: Figure 7 reveals an interesting contrast: accuracy generally declines with increasing update count , whereas added haystack produces little variation (45.3–48.3%) and recency shows model-dependent behavior.
sents.zh: 图 7 揭示了一个有趣的对比：随着更新次数的增加，准确率通常会下降，而添加的“干草堆”内容几乎不会造成变化（45.3%–48.3%），时效性则表现出因模型而异的行为。

sents.en: The subtype analysis ( Figure 5 ) further shows that lost/collapsed updates (30% of all errors) and stale values (27.1%) are the largest failure modes, while other reconstruction errors span update integration, entity tracking, and authority resolution.
sents.zh: 子类型分析（图 5）进一步表明，丢失/崩溃的更新（占所有错误的 30%）和过时的值（27.1%）是主要的失效模式，而其他重建错误则涉及更新整合、实体追踪和权限解析。

sents.en: Together, these results suggest that reliable memory requires a state-aware approach that preserves and reconciles accumulating updates across multiple state operations in the memory — which we prototype as a lightweight self-ledger in section 5 below.
sents.zh: 综合来看，这些结果表明，可靠的记忆需要一种具备状态感知能力的方法，该方法能够在记忆系统中跨多次状态操作保留并协调累积的更新——我们在下文第 5 节中将其原型设计为一个轻量级的自我账本。

paragraphs.en: Motivated by the preceding analysis, we ask: can this capability be improved? First , a natural approach is to increase reasoning effort , yet gains at higher effort are limited ( Figure 9 ). Critically, we found additional reasoning often elaborates on an incomplete or stale state but fails to recover the overlooked updates needed to correct it. Second , exploratory fine-tuning yields limited gains, indicating that this capability is not easily learned under the tested setup ( subsection D.4 ). Third , existing memory-management methods also underperform ( Table 2 ) as most compress visual histories into textual summaries which risks discarding precisely the fine-grained, state-bearing details these workflows require. Together with our finding in subsection 4.4 that reliable memory must preserve and reconcile accumulating updates, these observations suggest changing how state is maintained . We therefore explore a simple self-maintained ledger that explicitly records updates, retains their provenance, and reconciles their effects on the accepted state before answering, as shown in Figure 9 and subsection D.7 . These gains establish the ledger as a promising starting point for improving memory in professional workflows, while leaving substantial room for improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 基于上述分析，我们提出一个问题：这种能力能否得到提升？ 首先，一种自然的方法是增加推理投入，但更高投入带来的提升有限（图9）。 关键的是，我们发现额外的推理往往只是对不完整或过时的状态进行进一步阐述，却未能恢复纠正该状态所需的被忽略的更新。 其次，探索性微调带来的提升有限，表明在测试的设置下，这种能力不易被习得（D.4节）。 第三，现有的内存管理方法表现也不理想（表2），因为大多数方法将视觉历史压缩为文本摘要，这可能会丢弃这些工作流程所依赖的、承载状态信息的精细细节。 结合我们在4.4节中发现的可靠内存必须保存并协调累积更新这一结论，这些观察结果表明，改变状态的维护方式可能更为有效。 因此，我们探索了一种简单的自维护账本机制：在回答问题之前，它会明确记录更新、保留其来源，并协调这些更新对已接受状态的影响，如图9和D.7节所示。 这些提升表明，该账本机制是改善专业工作流程中内存能力的有前景的起点，但仍有较大的改进空间。

paragraphs.en: We introduced DSV-Mem, a benchmark and generation harness for evaluating dense stateful visual memory in conversational MLLM agents. Across realistic professional workflows, DSV-Mem shows that strong static visual understanding does not necessarily translate into reliable state maintenance: models often read individual artifacts correctly yet fail to reconcile textual and visual updates, distinguish near-identical revisions, preserve transition history, or reject stale premises. By providing controlled multimodal transitions, validated state graphs, and executable QA, DSV-Mem offers a rigorous testbed for diagnosing these failures and advancing reliable MLLM agents for long-running, evolving professional workflows.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 DSV-Mem，这是一个用于评估对话式 MLLM 智能体中密集状态视觉记忆能力的基准测试与生成框架。 在多种真实的专业工作流程中，DSV-Mem 表明，强大的静态视觉理解能力并不必然能转化为可靠的状态维持能力：模型常常能够正确识别单个视觉元素，却无法协调文本与视觉信息的更新、区分近乎相同的修订版本、保留状态转换历史，或拒绝使用过时的前提信息。 通过提供受控的多模态状态转换、经过验证的状态图以及可执行的问答任务，DSV-Mem 为诊断这些失败模式并推动开发可靠 MLLM 智能体以应对长期运行且不断变化的专业工作流程，提供了一个严谨的测试平台。

paragraphs.en: Although we document the generation harness, transition library, and validation procedures, regenerating DSV-Mem may produce different conversations and artifacts due to differences in models, agent implementations, and stochastic generation. This variability concerns dataset regeneration rather than evaluation on a fixed benchmark release.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管我们对生成框架、转换库和验证流程进行了记录，但由于模型、智能体实现和随机生成方面的差异，重新生成 DSV-Mem 可能会产生不同的对话和产物。 该框架对状态一致性和证据要求进行了约束，但无法保证不同生成运行中的输出完全相同或难度一致。 这种可变性涉及数据集的再生成，而非在固定基准版本上进行评估。

paragraphs.en: DSV-Mem is designed around properties motivated by professional workflows, including dense artifacts, repeated revisions, source-authority changes, and analytical queries. However, it is a researcher-constructed benchmark rather than a direct sample of deployed professional workflows. Its 1,000 questions also provide more limited breadth than very large-scale QA benchmarks; however, each question is grounded in a long, stateful multimodal workflow with many artifact versions and validated state transitions, making individual examples substantially more costly to construct and verify than isolated QA pairs. The current scale supports the controlled analyses reported here, while expanding to more workflows and questions would further strengthen coverage. We therefore do not claim that its scenarios reproduce the full distribution or complexity of real-world use, or that quantitative findings will transfer unchanged to deployment settings. Rather, DSV-Mem isolates and stress-tests a set of memory demands motivated by such workflows; evaluating transfer to naturally occurring professional interactions remains future work.
paragraphs.zh: DSV-Mem 的设计围绕专业工作流程所驱动的特性展开，包括密集的人工制品、反复的修订、来源权威性的变更以及分析性查询。 然而，这是一个由研究人员构建的基准测试，而非部署于实际专业工作流程的直接样本。 其包含的 1,000 个问题在广度上也远不及超大规模问答基准测试；不过，每个问题都基于一个长期、具备状态保持能力的多模态工作流程，涉及大量人工制品版本和经过验证的状态转换，这使得单个示例的构建与验证成本远高于孤立的问答对。 当前的规模足以支持本文报告的控制性分析，而扩展至更多工作流程和问题将进一步增强其覆盖范围。 因此，我们并未声称其场景能够复现真实世界使用的全部分布或复杂性，也未声称定量结果能够毫无变化地迁移到实际部署环境中。 相反，DSV-Mem 专门针对此类工作流程所驱动的一系列内存需求进行隔离与压力测试；评估这些需求能否迁移到自然发生的专业互动中，仍是未来的工作。

paragraphs.en: The self-ledger explored in section 5 is intended as a lightweight diagnostic prototype motivated by our analysis, rather than a new general-purpose memory architecture. paragraphs.en: DSV-Mem uses 27 domain-adaptable transition operators to represent updates in professional workflows. The library distinguishes how an update is introduced from how it changes the accepted state : a newly uploaded artifact may change displayed values without superseding an authoritative textual correction, while a textual correction may change the accepted state without changing the artifact. Thus, no single image or conversation turn necessarily contains the complete authoritative state.
paragraphs.zh: DSV-Mem 使用 27 种可适应领域的转换算子来表示专业工作流程中的更新。 该库区分了更新的引入方式与其对已接受状态的改变方式：新上传的工件可能改变显示值，但不会取代权威性的文本修正；而文本修正可能改变已接受状态，却不会改变工件本身。 因此，没有任何单一图像或对话回合必然包含完整的权威状态。

paragraphs.en: The harness samples eligible operators from the transition library ( subsection B.1 ) and generates updates one at a time. For each operator, an expert model or configured agent proposes a target scope and mutation; the orchestration agent checks its preconditions and resulting state, then applies, renders when needed, and commits the accepted update before proceeding. Invalid proposals are revised. Normal conversation blocks may occur between updates without changing task state. The harness separately maintains global accepted state and visual state, recording their divergences when textual corrections or authority declarations govern the accepted value. A canonical ledger records chronology, provenance, authority, and disregard/reinstatement events.
paragraphs.zh: 该框架从转换库（子部分 B.1）中采样符合条件的操作符，并逐个生成更新。 对于每个操作符，专家模型或配置好的智能体会提出目标范围和变异；协调智能体检查其前提条件和结果状态，然后在需要时应用、渲染，并在继续之前提交已接受的更新。 无效的提议会被修正。 在更新之间可能会出现正常的对话环节，而不会改变任务状态。 该框架会分别维护全局接受状态和视觉状态，并在文本修正或权限声明影响接受值时记录它们之间的差异。 一个标准账本会记录时间顺序、来源、权限以及忽略/恢复事件。

paragraphs.en: Beyond per-transition checks, the harness audits the complete trajectory for continuity across state snapshots, rendered artifacts, and provenance records. Checks cover schema validity, operator coverage, authority and lifecycle consistency, artifact–state alignment, and dependent computations. Each recorded post-state must agree with the declared update and its dependencies, and connect consistently to the next transition’s parent state. Blocking inconsistencies are repaired before dialogue realization.
paragraphs.zh: 除了每次状态转换的检查之外，该测试框架还会审计整个轨迹，确保其在状态快照、渲染出的产物以及来源记录之间保持连贯性。 检查涵盖模式有效性、操作符覆盖范围、权限与生命周期一致性、产物与状态的对应关系，以及依赖计算。 每个记录后的状态都必须与声明的更新及其依赖项一致，并且要与下一次状态转换的父状态保持连贯连接。 在实现对话之前，会先修复那些导致阻塞的不一致性问题。

paragraphs.en: Two-model role-play realizes the validated structural turns as a coherent professional conversation. It preserves the approved updates, their order, and associated artifacts while adding natural interaction around them. Checks enforce turn completeness, non-repetition, semantic parity with the validated trajectory, and compliance with information-disclosure rules. In particular, dialogue must neither introduce unrecorded state changes nor reveal future updates or hidden state records; visual-only changes must remain recoverable from the artifacts rather than being transcribed into the dialogue.

paragraphs.en: The harness constructs compositional questions covering Current State, Past State, Derived State, Change History, and Conflict/Refusal. Each item records its target state operation, gold answer and derivation, and supporting evidence references. We apply the cross-visual criterion defined in the main paper, retaining questions that require at least two distinct visual artifacts given the conversation text. Gold answers are checked against the validated state trajectory, with independent recomputation for derived quantities and checks for clarity and unique answerability. The resulting questions and evidence undergo the benchmark audits described in the main paper; erroneous items are corrected or replaced. Evaluated models receive the visible conversation and permitted evidence, not the internal state graph or gold derivations.
paragraphs.zh: 该框架构建组合式问题，涵盖当前状态、过去状态、派生状态、变更历史和冲突/拒绝。 每个条目记录其目标状态操作、标准答案与推导过程，以及支持性证据的引用。 我们应用主论文中定义的跨视觉标准，保留那些在给定对话文本时需要至少两种不同视觉产物才能回答的问题。 标准答案会与经过验证的状态轨迹进行核对，对派生量进行独立重新计算，并检查答案的清晰度和唯一可答性。 最终生成的问题和证据会经过主论文中描述的基准审计；存在错误的条目会被修正或替换。 被评估的模型将获得可见的对话内容和允许使用的证据，而非内部状态图或标准答案的推导过程。

paragraphs.en: We organize questions around how users consult evolving professional records in a sustained workflow. Users may ask what is currently authoritative, recover an earlier decision, compare or compute over accepted records, review how a value changed, or make a request whose premise conflicts with the available evidence. These needs motivate our three families: authority-aware state resolution , stateful change tracking , and state-based conflict/refusal . The five categories distinguish the primary operation needed to satisfy the request, rather than treating all questions as retrieval of previously mentioned facts. The examples below illustrate these question forms; they are not verbatim benchmark items.
paragraphs.zh: 我们围绕用户如何在持续的工作流程中查阅不断变化的专业记录来组织问题。 用户可能会询问当前哪些信息具有权威性，恢复先前的决策，对已接受记录进行比较或计算，审查某个数值如何变化，或者提出一个前提与现有证据相冲突的请求。 这些需求促使我们形成了三个类别：权威感知状态解析、状态化变更追踪以及基于状态的冲突/拒绝。 这五个类别区分了满足请求所需的主要操作，而不是将所有问题都视为对先前提及事实的检索。 下面的例子说明了这些问题的形式；它们并非逐字照搬的基准测试条目。

paragraphs.en: Professional records are repeatedly revised, so answering a factual question requires identifying the state that governs the user’s request. We distinguish three forms of this need:
paragraphs.zh: 专业记录会经过反复修订，因此回答一个事实性问题需要确定与用户请求相关的状态。 我们将这种需求区分为三种形式：

sents.en: Professional records are repeatedly revised, so answering a factual question requires identifying the state that governs the user’s request.
sents.zh: 专业记录会经过反复修订，因此回答一个事实性问题需要确定与用户请求相关的状态。

sents.en: We distinguish three forms of this need:
sents.zh: 我们将这种需求区分为三种形式：

paragraphs.en: Current State (100 questions). Users need the accepted information on which to act now. For example, “What is the approved budget for Project A after the latest corrections?” This motivates evaluating authoritative-state resolution, rather than merely reading the newest artifact.
paragraphs.zh: 当前状态（100个问题）。 用户需要已接受的信息，以便据此立即采取行动。 例如：“在最新修正之后，项目A的批准预算是多少？”这促使我们评估权威状态的解决结果，而不仅仅是阅读最新的成果文件。

paragraphs.en: Past State (100 questions). Users also revisit earlier decisions or reconstruct what was accepted at a particular stage. For example, “What budget was approved immediately before the scope revision?” This motivates retaining historical snapshots rather than overwriting memory with only the current state.
paragraphs.zh: 过往状态（100个问题）。 用户也会重新审视早期的决策，或重构在特定阶段所接受的内容。 例如：“在范围修订之前立即批准的是多少预算？”这促使我们保留历史快照，而不是仅用当前状态覆盖记忆。

paragraphs.en: Derived State (200 questions). Practical requests often require analysis rather than repetition of a stored value. paragraphs.en: Together, these categories test whether memory supports current decisions, retrospective inspection, and analysis over evolving records.
paragraphs.zh: 这些类别共同检验了记忆是否支持当前的决策、回顾性检查以及对不断演变的记录进行分析。

paragraphs.en: A final value does not explain the sequence of decisions that produced it. Users may need to audit revisions, review changes, or establish how often a field was updated. Change History (350 questions) captures this need. For example, “How many accepted budget changes occurred after the initial approval, and what were the successive amounts?” Two conversations can end with the same budget while having different update histories; endpoint retrieval alone therefore cannot answer this request. This category evaluates whether models preserve the relevant trajectory, including the effects of disregard and reinstatement, rather than collapsing it into a final summary.
paragraphs.zh: 最终值无法解释产生该值的决策序列。 用户可能需要审计修订版本、审查变更，或确定某个字段被更新的频率。 “变更历史”（350个问题）满足了这一需求。 例如：“在初始批准之后，发生了多少次预算变更的接受操作？这些变更的连续金额分别是多少？”两次对话可能以相同的预算结束，但更新历史却不同；因此，仅通过获取最终结果无法回答这一问题。 该类别评估模型是否能够保留相关的演变过程（包括忽略和重新采纳所产生的影响），而不是将其简化为一个最终摘要。

paragraphs.en: Users may refer to an outdated value, assume that an unresolved decision has been finalized, or request a conclusion that the records do not support. Conflict/Refusal (250 questions) evaluates whether models recognize these conditions instead of accepting the premise and producing an unsupported answer. For example, “Using the finalized budget, calculate the remaining allocation” is not answerable as stated if conflicting revisions remain unresolved. The appropriate response is to identify that issue rather than invent a finalized value. The design targets evidence-grounded correction or refusal, not refusal as a default behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 用户可能会参考一个过时的数值，假设一个未决的决定已经最终确定，或者要求得出一个记录中并无依据的结论。 “冲突/拒绝”（250个问题）用于评估模型是否能够识别这些情况，而不是接受前提并生成一个缺乏依据的答案。 例如，如果存在尚未解决的冲突性修订，“使用已最终确定的预算计算剩余分配额”这一问题就无法按原样回答。 适当的回应是指出该问题，而不是凭空编造一个最终确定的数值。 该设计旨在实现基于证据的纠正或拒绝，而非将拒绝作为默认行为。

paragraphs.en: These categories organize user needs without assuming that the underlying operations are independent. A comparison may require recovering past states, and a conflict check may require tracing which update superseded another. We therefore assign each question to its primary requested operation while allowing multiple supporting operations. Across all categories, questions must satisfy the shared cross-visual evidence requirement. This design connects recognizable professional requests to the benchmark’s central challenge: preserving and reasoning over authoritative state as dense visual records evolve .
paragraphs.zh: 这些类别对用户需求的组织方式并未假设其底层操作相互独立。 一次比较可能需要恢复过去的状态，而冲突检查则可能需要追溯哪项更新取代了另一项更新。 因此，我们将每个问题分配给其主要请求的操作，同时允许存在多个辅助操作。 在所有类别中，问题都必须满足共同的跨视觉证据要求。 这种设计将可识别的专业请求与基准的核心挑战联系起来：在密集视觉记录不断演变的过程中，保持并推理权威状态。

paragraphs.en: Automated checks cover schema integrity, state continuity, dependent computations, and consistency between evidence and authority records. Six domain experts, three PhD students, and five additional graduate students participated in reviewing scenario artifacts and transition trajectories. Review criteria include professional realism, appropriate terminology and units, plausible updates, and correct propagation of their consequences. Across three successive checks, we replaced 32, 16, and 1 questions, respectively, totaling 49 replacements (~5% of the benchmark size).
paragraphs.zh: 自动化检查涵盖模式完整性、状态连续性、依赖计算以及证据与权威记录之间的一致性。 六位领域专家、三位博士生和另外五名研究生参与了场景工件和转换轨迹的评审工作。 评审标准包括专业真实性、恰当的术语和单位、合理的更新，以及其后果的正确传播。 在三次连续的检查中，我们分别替换了 32、16 和 1 个问题，总计 49 个替换（约占基准规模的 5%）。

paragraphs.en: Three PhD students independently reviewed the same 100 randomly sampled questions, answering each before checking the supplied gold answer. Their gold-answer correctness ratings were 99%, 97%, and 99%, and question-clarity ratings were 97%, 98%, and 98%, respectively. Visual-evidence inconsistency rates were 1%, 2%, and 1%. paragraphs.en: On the audited sample, text-only evaluation achieves 2% accuracy, while supplying only the best supporting image achieves 1%, supporting the need for cross-visual evidence. When supplied with the supporting artifacts and extracted answer-relevant values, Gemini 3.7 Flash achieves 93% accuracy. This result supports our finding that obtaining and maintaining the required evidence and state correctly is the main challenge, rather than subsequent answer computation. These benchmark-level checks complement the seven results-validation procedures in section 4 , detailed in subsection C.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 在受审计的样本中，仅使用文本进行评估的准确率为 2%，而仅提供最佳支持性图像时的准确率为 1%，这印证了交叉视觉证据的必要性。 当提供支持性辅助材料以及提取出的与答案相关的值时，Gemini 3.7 Flash 的准确率达到 93%。 这一结果支持我们的发现：获取并正确维持所需的证据和状态是主要挑战，而非后续的答案计算。 这些基准级别的检查补充了第 4 节中的七项结果验证程序，具体细节见 C.5 小节。

paragraphs.en: Prompt variants. Using Gemini 3.7 Flash Medium as the baseline, we evaluate chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting ( Wei et al., 2022 ) , an explicit state-tracking hint, and three semantically equivalent rewrites of each question. We additionally evaluate CoT and hint prompting with Kimi K3 High. These controls test the effects of reasoning instructions and sensitivity to question phrasing.
paragraphs.zh: 提示变体。 以 Gemini 3.7 Flash Medium 为基准，我们评估了链式思维（CoT）提示（Wei et al., 2022）、一种显式的状态跟踪提示，以及每个问题的三种语义等价的改写版本。 我们还使用 Kimi K3 High 评估了 CoT 和提示引导方法。 这些对照实验旨在检验推理指令的效果以及对问题表述的敏感性。

paragraphs.en: Following Ren et al. (2026) ; Bei et al. (2026) , we adopt a web-style conversational setting, appending each question as the final user turn and evaluating it independently. Unaugmented models receive the complete conversation and all visible multimodal evidence; memory-management methods instead use retrieved memories and question-attached images. Neither setting provides oracle state graphs or answer-revealing metadata, such as informative filenames. External memory is reset between scenarios and may contain only information derived from the visible interaction. We report accuracy for each of the five categories, Category Avg. as their unweighted mean, and Total Avg. as accuracy over all questions. Unless otherwise specified, results report the mean and sample standard deviation over three independent runs ; rows marked † report a single run.

paragraphs.en: Table 3 compares Kimi K3 with four memory-management methods under high reasoning effort. All four underperform the baseline overall, achieving 5.4–15.5% accuracy versus 24.3%, although SimpleMem and MIRIX improve Conflict/Refusal to 21.2% and 16.4%, respectively. As discussed in subsection 4.1 , many of these integrations compress visual histories into textual memories without re-attaching the visual images ( subsection D.6 ), risking the loss of fine-grained, state-bearing details needed for later queries. These results reinforce the challenge posed by DSV-Mem: generic summarization may not preserve the dense details and update history required in professional workflows.
paragraphs.zh: 表3在高推理负荷条件下比较了 Kimi K3 与四种记忆管理方法。 这四种方法在整体表现上均低于基线模型，准确率仅为 5.4%–15.5%，而基线为 24.3%；不过，SimpleMem 和 MIRIX 分别将冲突/拒绝处理准确率提升至 21.2% 和 16.4%。 如第 4.1 小节所述，许多此类整合方法将视觉历史压缩为文本记忆，而未重新附加视觉图像（D.6 小节），这可能导致后续查询所需的精细状态相关细节丢失。 这些结果进一步凸显了 DSV-Mem 带来的挑战：通用的摘要生成方法可能无法保留专业工作流程中所需的密集细节和更新历史。

paragraphs.en: We expand the error analysis in subsection 4.2 to clarify where failures arise and which state operations they involve. The analysis distinguishes failures to acquire evidence from failures to reconstruct its authoritative state, compute over that state, or produce an appropriate response.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在第 4.2 小节中扩展了错误分析，以明确故障出现的位置以及它们涉及哪些状态操作。 该分析区分了获取证据的失败与重构其权威状态、在该状态上进行计算或生成适当响应的失败。

paragraphs.en: We classify all incorrect responses (Gemini-3.7-flash, Kimi-K3, MiniMax-M3, and Qwen3.5-397B-A17B) by the earliest failure stage into five categories: 1) evidence acquisition , retrieving the wrong artifact or misreading visual content; 2) state reconstruction , incorrectly tracking, retaining, or reconciling updates across the conversation; 3) downstream computation , performing incorrect arithmetic over correctly reconstructed state; 4) decision/response , missed refusals, hallucinations, or incorrect answers despite correct preceding reasoning; and 5) other , failures not covered by these categories. Labels are assigned by majority vote among GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.6, and Gemini 3.1 Pro, with unanimous agreement on 87% of responses. Three PhD students independently classify 200 sampled incorrect responses, achieving 87% unanimous agreement. Human-majority labels agree with automated classifications in 96% of cases and attribute 85% of failures to state reconstruction, corroborating its dominance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将所有错误响应（Gemini-3.7-flash、Kimi-K3、MiniMax-M3 和 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B）按照最早出现的故障阶段分为五类：1）证据获取，即检索到错误的资料或误读视觉内容；2）状态重建，即在对话过程中错误地跟踪、保留或协调更新信息；3）下游计算，即基于正确重建的状态执行错误的算术运算；4）决策/响应，即尽管前面的推理正确，但仍出现拒绝判断失误、幻觉或错误答案；以及 5）其他，即不属于上述类别的故障。 标签由 GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.6 和 Gemini 3.1 Pro 通过多数投票法确定，其中 87% 的响应获得了全体一致同意。 三名博士生独立对 200 个抽样错误响应进行分类，达成 87% 的一致同意率。 人类主导的标签在 96% 的情况下与自动化分类结果一致，并将 85% 的故障归因于状态重建，从而证实了该阶段的主导地位。

paragraphs.en: The earliest-stage criterion distinguishes the source of an error from its downstream consequences. For example, computing a total from a superseded value is a state-reconstruction failure when the arithmetic itself is correct. Similarly, an incorrect response caused by a missed authoritative correction is attributed to state reconstruction rather than counted again as a decision/response error.
paragraphs.zh: 最早阶段的判据能够区分错误的来源与其下游后果。 例如，当计算本身正确时，使用已被取代的值来计算总和属于状态重建失败。 同样地，因未采纳权威更正而导致的错误响应，应归因于状态重建，而非再次计为决策/响应错误。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 5 a, state reconstruction accounts for 89.7% of errors , substantially exceeding decision/response (5.5%), evidence acquisition (3.5%), and downstream computation (1.0%). The dominant challenge is therefore not extracting an isolated value or computing with it, but determining which values and updates remain authoritative in the evolving conversation. A model may correctly read an artifact yet answer incorrectly because it overlooks a later correction, retains a withdrawn update, or combines values from incompatible states.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 5a 所示，状态重建占错误的 89.7%，远高于决策/响应（5.5%）、证据获取（3.5%）和下游计算（1.0%）。 因此，主要挑战并非提取某个孤立值或基于该值进行计算，而是确定在不断发展的对话中，哪些值和更新仍然具有权威性。 模型可能正确读取某个产物，却给出错误答案，因为它忽略了后续的更正、保留了已撤回的更新，或将来自不兼容状态的值组合在了一起。

paragraphs.en: Evidence acquisition and downstream computation together account for only 4.5% of errors, indicating that visual reading and arithmetic are not the primary bottlenecks in this evaluation. This finding is consistent with the visual-reading control, which achieves 98.5% accuracy, and the evidence-supplied validation, in which Gemini 3.7 Flash achieves 93% accuracy when provided with the supporting evidence ( section 4 ). Together, these results support the distinction between reading available evidence and reconstructing the authoritative state needed to answer a question.
paragraphs.zh: 证据获取和下游计算总共仅占错误的 4.5%，这表明视觉阅读和算术并非本次评估中的主要瓶颈。 这一发现与视觉阅读控制（准确率为 98.5%）以及提供证据的验证（当提供支持性证据时，Gemini 3.7 Flash 的准确率达到 93%）的结果一致（第 4 节）。 综合来看，这些结果支持将获取可用证据与重构回答问题所需的权威状态区分开来的观点。

paragraphs.en: State reconstruction dominates across the category groups in Figure 5 b. Although their outputs differ, these tasks share a prerequisite: identifying the operative state and its supporting updates. Current and Past State questions require selecting the correct state at the relevant point; Derived State questions require reconstructing that state before computation; Change History questions require retaining the accepted update sequence; and Conflict/Refusal questions require checking a request against the maintained state. Consequently, a reconstruction failure can affect all five categories rather than appearing only in questions explicitly asking about update history.
paragraphs.zh: 在图 5b 的各个类别组中，状态重建都占据主导地位。 尽管这些任务的输出不同，但它们有一个共同的前提：识别当前有效的状态及其支持性更新。 当前状态和历史状态问题要求在相关时间点选择正确的状态；派生状态问题要求在进行计算前重建该状态；变更历史问题要求保留已接受的更新序列；而冲突/拒绝问题则需要将请求与已维护的状态进行核对。 因此，状态重建的失败可能会影响所有五个类别，而不仅仅出现在明确询问更新历史的问题中。

sents.en: State reconstruction dominates across the category groups in Figure 5 b.
sents.zh: 在图 5b 的各个类别组中，状态重建都占据主导地位。

sents.en: Although their outputs differ, these tasks share a prerequisite: identifying the operative state and its supporting updates.
sents.zh: 尽管这些任务的输出不同，但它们有一个共同的前提：识别当前有效的状态及其支持性更新。

sents.en: Current and Past State questions require selecting the correct state at the relevant point; Derived State questions require reconstructing that state before computation; Change History questions require retaining the accepted update sequence; and Conflict/Refusal questions require checking a request against the maintained state.
sents.zh: 当前状态和历史状态问题要求在相关时间点选择正确的状态；派生状态问题要求在进行计算前重建该状态；变更历史问题要求保留已接受的更新序列；而冲突/拒绝问题则需要将请求与已维护的状态进行核对。

sents.en: Consequently, a reconstruction failure can affect all five categories rather than appearing only in questions explicitly asking about update history.
sents.zh: 因此，状态重建的失败可能会影响所有五个类别，而不仅仅出现在明确询问更新历史的问题中。

paragraphs.en: We further classify state-reconstruction errors by their dominant erroneous state operation ( Figure 5 c). Lost/collapsed updates account for 30% of all errors , while stale values account for 27.1% . The former occurs when a governing update is omitted or collapsed during reconstruction, so its effect is absent from the maintained history or state. The latter occurs when a superseded value remains in use despite an operative replacement. These subtypes distinguish failure to preserve an update from failure to resolve which value it makes authoritative. Their percentages use all incorrect responses as the denominator, not only state-reconstruction errors.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还根据主导的错误状态操作对状态重建错误进行了进一步分类（图 5c）。 丢失/崩溃的更新在所有错误中占 30%，而过时的值则占 27.1%。 前者发生在重建过程中遗漏或合并了某个控制性更新，导致其影响未体现在所维护的历史记录或状态中。 后者发生在存在有效替代值的情况下，旧值仍被继续使用。 这些子类型区分了未能保留更新与未能确定该更新使哪个值具有权威性这两种情况。 它们的百分比以所有错误响应为分母，而不仅仅是状态重建错误。

sents.zh: 我们还根据主导的错误状态操作对状态重建错误进行了进一步分类（图 5c）。

sents.en: Lost/collapsed updates account for 30% of all errors , while stale values account for 27.1% .
sents.zh: 丢失/崩溃的更新在所有错误中占 30%，而过时的值则占 27.1%。

sents.zh: 后者发生在存在有效替代值的情况下，旧值仍被继续使用。

sents.en: These subtypes distinguish failure to preserve an update from failure to resolve which value it makes authoritative.
sents.zh: 这些子类型区分了未能保留更新与未能确定该更新使哪个值具有权威性这两种情况。

sents.en: Their percentages use all incorrect responses as the denominator, not only state-reconstruction errors.
sents.zh: 它们的百分比以所有错误响应为分母，而不仅仅是状态重建错误。

paragraphs.en: The remaining subtypes span computation on the wrong state, entity tracking, withdrawn values, authority resolution, and update integration. Each accounts for approximately 10% or less of all errors, but together they demonstrate that reconstruction is not reducible to a single operation. Retaining an update is insufficient if it is associated with the wrong entity, treated as authoritative outside its scope, or combined incorrectly with other changes. Likewise, selecting the latest displayed value is insufficient when a textual correction or withdrawal determines the accepted state.
paragraphs.zh: 其余子类型涵盖了在错误状态上的计算、实体跟踪、已撤回的值、权限解析以及更新集成等问题。 每种情况约占所有错误的 10% 或更少，但综合来看，它们表明重构无法简化为单一操作。 如果某个更新与错误实体相关联、在其作用域之外被当作权威信息处理，或与其他变更结合不当，那么仅保留该更新是不足够的。 同样地，当文本修正或撤回决定了被接受的状态时，仅仅选择最新显示的值也是不够的。

paragraphs.en: These findings complement the update-count analysis in Figure 7 , where accuracy generally declines as more governing updates must be integrated. Together, the update-count trend and diverse error subtypes suggest that reliable memory requires a state-aware approach: preserving and reconciling accumulating updates across multiple state operations . This explains why DSV-Mem tests more than isolated visual recognition or retrieval: successful answers depend on maintaining the authoritative evolution of dense professional artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 这些发现补充了图 7 中的更新次数分析，在该分析中，随着需要整合的更多控制性更新，准确性通常会下降。 更新次数的趋势和多样的错误子类型共同表明，可靠的记忆需要一种状态感知的方法：在多次状态操作中保存并协调累积的更新。 这解释了为什么 DSV-Mem 测试的不仅仅是孤立的视觉识别或检索：成功的答案取决于维持密集专业成果物的权威演化过程。

paragraphs.en: We explore whether supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on final-answer labels improves DSV-Mem performance using Qwen3.5-9B. We consider two settings: an in-domain 80/20 train–test split and a cross-scenario split using eight scenarios for training and two held-out scenarios for evaluation. Training supervises only the gold answer, without intermediate evidence-selection, state-reconstruction, or reasoning traces.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Qwen3.5-9B 探索在最终答案标签上进行监督微调（SFT）是否能提升 DSV-Mem 的性能。 我们考虑两种设置：一种是在领域内按 80/20 的比例划分训练集和测试集；另一种是使用八个场景进行训练，并保留两个场景用于评估的跨场景划分。 训练过程仅对标准答案进行监督，不涉及中间证据选择、状态重建或推理痕迹的监督。

sents.en: We explore whether supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on final-answer labels improves DSV-Mem performance using Qwen3.5-9B.
sents.zh: 我们使用 Qwen3.5-9B 探索在最终答案标签上进行监督微调（SFT）是否能提升 DSV-Mem 的性能。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 4 , Conflict/Refusal improves from 4.8% to 26.6% in-domain and from 5.6% to 24.5% on held-out scenarios, suggesting that this category is more amenable to final-answer supervision. In contrast, Current State, Past State, Derived State, and Change History remain close to baseline and do not reflect broad improvement in state reconstruction.
paragraphs.zh: 如表 4 所示，冲突/拒绝（Conflict/Refusal）在领域内数据中的准确率从 4.8% 提升至 26.6%，在预留场景中的准确率从 5.6% 提升至 24.5%，这表明这一类别更容易通过最终答案监督进行优化。 相比之下，当前状态（Current State）、过去状态（Past State）、派生状态（Derived State）和变化历史（Change History）的准确率仍接近基线水平，并未体现出状态重建方面的广泛改进。

sents.en: As shown in Table 4 , Conflict/Refusal improves from 4.8% to 26.6% in-domain and from 5.6% to 24.5% on held-out scenarios, suggesting that this category is more amenable to final-answer supervision.
sents.zh: 如表 4 所示，冲突/拒绝（Conflict/Refusal）在领域内数据中的准确率从 4.8% 提升至 26.6%，在预留场景中的准确率从 5.6% 提升至 24.5%，这表明这一类别更容易通过最终答案监督进行优化。

paragraphs.en: Label-only supervision provides a target answer without explicitly teaching the intermediate operations required to obtain it: selecting relevant visual evidence, preserving governing updates, and reconciling their cumulative effects before answering. The limited gains outside Conflict/Refusal are consistent with the state-reconstruction bottleneck identified in subsection 4.2 . These results suggest that final-answer SFT alone, under the tested configuration, is insufficient to substantially improve this capability; supervision targeting evidence selection and state evolution remains a promising direction.
paragraphs.zh: 仅标签的监督方式提供了目标答案，但并未明确教授获得该答案所需的中间操作：选择相关的视觉证据、保留控制性更新，并在作答前协调这些更新的累积效应。 在冲突/拒绝场景之外取得的有限收益，与第 4.2 小节中识别出的状态重建瓶颈一致。 这些结果表明，在测试的配置下，仅通过最终答案的 SFT 不足以显著提升这一能力；针对证据选择和状态演变的监督仍是一个有前景的方向。

paragraphs.en: Table 5 reports Gemini 3.7 Flash Medium performance across the ten scenarios. Mean accuracy ranges from 18.0% on incident-postmortem reconciliation to 81.0% on robotics evaluation, with eight scenarios below 50%. Although performance varies substantially across scenarios, the aggregate difficulty is not confined to a single workflow. The scenario-level spread also highlights heterogeneous workflow difficulty; its relationship to update count, artifact density, and authority-operation mix remains an important direction for further analysis. Each scenario contains 100 questions with the same category distribution, so the overall score equally weights the ten scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 表 5 报告了 Gemini 3.7 Flash Medium 在十个场景中的表现。 平均准确率从事件事后核对的 18.0% 到机器人评估的 81.0% 不等，其中八个场景的准确率低于 50%。 尽管不同场景的表现差异显著，但整体难度并未局限于单一工作流程。 场景层面的差异也凸显了工作流程难度的异质性；其与更新次数、工件密度以及权限操作组合之间的关系，仍然是进一步分析的重要方向。 每个场景都包含 100 个问题，且类别分布相同，因此总得分对十个场景给予同等权重。

paragraphs.en: By design, these methods typically distill interaction histories into compact memories and answer using retrieved memories at inference time. Subsequent answers therefore depend on what survives memory construction and retrieval. We supply historical visual information during construction: SimpleMem and LightMem receive detailed, question-independent transcriptions through their text-based interfaces, while Mem0 and MIRIX receive images directly through their multimodal ingestion interfaces. To reduce transcription loss, the configured model is explicitly instructed to preserve labels, values, statuses, spatial groupings, and formatting cues. Each method then applies its own memory-construction and retrieval procedures to the chronological conversation.
paragraphs.zh: 这些方法的设计通常是将交互历史提炼为紧凑的记忆，并在推理阶段利用检索到的记忆来回答问题。 因此，后续的回答取决于在记忆构建和检索过程中保留下来的内容。 我们在构建过程中提供历史视觉信息：SimpleMem 和 LightMem 通过其文本接口接收详细且与问题无关的转录文本，而 Mem0 和 MIRIX 则通过其多模态输入接口直接接收图像。 为减少转录过程中的信息丢失，我们明确指示配置好的模型保留标签、数值、状态、空间分组以及格式提示。 随后，每种方法都会针对按时间顺序排列的对话，执行其专属的记忆构建与检索流程。

paragraphs.en: At answer time, the backbone receives retrieved textual memories and any question-attached images. Historical visual information is therefore mediated by constructed memories, rather than withheld during ingestion. Their underperformance on DSV-Mem highlights the challenge of preserving dense, state-bearing details through this process. This also partially motivates our self-ledger design: preserving update-level records and source links allows fine-grained details to be revisited rather than relying solely on compressed representations. Memory construction is scenario-specific and question-independent, using only visible evidence without gold answers or hidden state graphs.
paragraphs.zh: 在回答阶段，主干模型会接收检索到的文本记忆以及与问题相关的任何图像。 因此，历史视觉信息是通过构建的记忆进行传递的，而不是在输入阶段就被排除在外。 它们在 DSV-Mem 任务中的表现不佳，凸显了在此过程中保留密集且承载状态细节的挑战。 这也部分启发了我们的自账本设计：保留更新级别的记录和数据源链接，使得细粒度细节可以被重新审视，而无需完全依赖压缩后的表示。 记忆构建是特定于场景且独立于问题的，仅使用可见的证据，而不依赖标准答案或隐藏的状态图。

paragraphs.en: We explore a training-free self-ledger that explicitly preserves updates and their provenance. The model processes the conversation in chronological windows, using visible dialogue and images, image-derived OCR, and visual-difference hints. It appends entity–field events recording observed values, changes, source turns, and authority cues, while maintaining a compact index of entity aliases, standing instructions, and unresolved conflicts. Displayed values are distinguished from accepted working values, allowing textual corrections or rejected visual revisions to remain explicit without overwriting history.
paragraphs.zh: 我们探索了一种无需训练的自记录系统，该系统明确保留更新及其来源信息。 该模型按时间窗口处理对话，利用可见的对话内容、图像、图像提取的 OCR 文本以及视觉差异提示。 它会追加记录观测值、变化、源轮次和权威线索的实体–字段事件，同时维护一个包含实体别名、固定指令和未解决冲突的紧凑索引。 显示的值与已接受的当前值有所区分，这使得文本修正或被拒绝的视觉修订能够保持明确，而不会覆盖历史记录。

sents.en: We explore a training-free self-ledger that explicitly preserves updates and their provenance.
sents.zh: 我们探索了一种无需训练的自记录系统，该系统明确保留更新及其来源信息。

sents.en: The model processes the conversation in chronological windows, using visible dialogue and images, image-derived OCR, and visual-difference hints.
sents.zh: 该模型按时间窗口处理对话，利用可见的对话内容、图像、图像提取的 OCR 文本以及视觉差异提示。

sents.en: It appends entity–field events recording observed values, changes, source turns, and authority cues, while maintaining a compact index of entity aliases, standing instructions, and unresolved conflicts.
sents.zh: 它会追加记录观测值、变化、源轮次和权威线索的实体–字段事件，同时维护一个包含实体别名、固定指令和未解决冲突的紧凑索引。

sents.en: Displayed values are distinguished from accepted working values, allowing textual corrections or rejected visual revisions to remain explicit without overwriting history.
sents.zh: 显示的值与已接受的当前值有所区分，这使得文本修正或被拒绝的视觉修订能够保持明确，而不会覆盖历史记录。

paragraphs.en: The ledger is frozen before evaluation questions are introduced. For each question, a retrieval step selects relevant events, temporal scope, source dialogue, and original visual evidence. The model uses this evidence to check an initial answer and produce a ledger-assisted draft; a final arbitration step reconciles the candidate answers against their visible sources. Ledger construction receives no evaluation questions, gold answers, or benchmark state graphs. This exploratory procedure tests whether explicit update preservation and reconciliation can improve performance without model training.
paragraphs.zh: 在引入评估问题之前，账本处于冻结状态。 对于每个问题，检索步骤会选择相关事件、时间范围、源对话以及原始视觉证据。 模型利用这些证据来验证初步答案并生成由账本辅助的初稿；最终的仲裁步骤会将候选答案与它们可见的来源进行比对协调。 账本构建过程不会接收任何评估问题、标准答案或基准状态图。 这一探索性流程旨在测试：在无需模型训练的情况下，显式保留更新并进行协调是否能够有效提升性能。

sents.zh: 在引入评估问题之前，账本处于冻结状态。

sents.zh: 对于每个问题，检索步骤会选择相关事件、时间范围、源对话以及原始视觉证据。

sents.en: The model uses this evidence to check an initial answer and produce a ledger-assisted draft; a final arbitration step reconciles the candidate answers against their visible sources.
sents.zh: 模型利用这些证据来验证初步答案并生成由账本辅助的初稿；最终的仲裁步骤会将候选答案与它们可见的来源进行比对协调。

sents.zh: 账本构建过程不会接收任何评估问题、标准答案或基准状态图。
